name: Realm Favor
description: Larry's favor swells while you are inside your realm (+1 every 1.5 s) and drains while you are away (-1 every 3 s). 81-100 Ascendant: Strength II, Speed II, Resistance II, Regeneration, +4 hearts, Wither III gaze. 61-80 Empowered: Strength, Speed, Resistance. 41-60 Neutral. 21-40 Withered: Weakness, Slowness. 0-20 Hollow: Weakness II, Slowness II, Mining Fatigue, -3 hearts.
